# Marks fixtures

`expected/` holds what jahala/plotplot's `scripts/marks.py` printed at tag v1.9.0, run on
`../brand-plotplot-v1.9.0/.brand` (the v1.9.0 marks, night files and tokens.css), on
2026-11-05: its `--check` message and `tile <bed> [--night]` for plotplot, copeca, tend and
umbel. petals' `marks.py` must reproduce them byte for byte (issue #17).

On 2026-11-05 the night-file note changed to name `petals/scripts/marks.py`, at plotplot's request, after the script moved into petals. The night files and the night tiles here differ from plotplot v1.9.0 in that one line only.
